speaker: Doctor
text: WELCOME, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress. To understand the cause, how many weeks pregnant was your mother when you were born?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) due to prematurity at 33 weeks gestation. Given the history of no significant prenatal care and immediate onset of distress, I am requesting a Chest_X-Ray to confirm ground-glass opacities typical of surfactant deficiency.
